prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a finished cinematic opening TITLE TYPOGRAPHY asset, TWO lines, isolated on a truly TRANSPARENT RGBA background. This is typography only, not a movie poster or scene.

Primary request: a refined, dignified imperial film title for the opening of a game set in the Forbidden City. The attached courtyard is only a palette and mood reference. DO NOT reproduce any of its scenery, roofs, people, walls, light, or background. Output ONLY the two exact text lines with transparent space around and between them and inside all counters.

Exact text, line 1: KIELLETTY KAUPUNKI
Exact text, line 2: 1914
Line 1 spelling: K I E L L E T T Y [word space] K A U P U N K I.
Line 2 spelling: one nine one four.
No other letters, words, punctuation, subtitles, labels, Chinese characters, emblems, logos, signatures or decorative objects. Do not add Beijing or Peking.

Typography: beautiful classical Roman inscription serif capitals, like refined Trajan-style cinematic titling. Elegant balanced thick and thin strokes, sharply drawn refined wedge serifs, generous even letter spacing. Neither a plain modern sans serif nor ornate calligraphy. Meticulously legible complete characters. Use a restrained warm ivory / very pale champagne gold fill, approximately #F2E6CA, and a continuous THIN dark warm charcoal-brown outline, approximately #30261D, around every letter and number. Outline must make the title readable over bright sky and golden rooftops while remaining thin and elegant. Minimal engraving-like internal tonal refinement is allowed, but no heavy 3D extrusion, glitter, metal corrosion, grunge, painted texture, glow, big drop shadow or ornamental border.

Layout: landscape title plate, aim for 3000 x 900 native pixels or largest available wide output. Main title stays on exactly ONE long horizontal line, centered, spanning about 88 to 92 percent of canvas width. Maintain safe transparent space beyond every serif. The year is centered on the second line, clearly smaller: its character height approximately 50 percent of the title's capital height and its total width approximately 16 to 20 percent of the title width. A quiet clear transparent gap separates the two lines, allowing them to be exported separately for independent fades. No separator line or ornament. Place the paired title around the vertical center of the transparent canvas, not at the top edge; its position on screen will be handled later.

Constraints: true transparent alpha, no opaque black/white background, no fake checkerboard painted into the pixels, no background plate, no box, no frame, no vignette, no scenery. Both lines in the exact same typeface and pale warm color with thin dark outline. Sharp professional high-resolution typography. Preserve every letter, word space, and all four digits exactly. Generate the entire two-line title as a single new finished asset.

Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: a high-resolution cinematic YEAR typography asset, isolated on truly TRANSPARENT RGBA.

The supplied transparent two-line title defines the exact font design, pale champagne ivory fill and thin dark warm brown outline. Generate a complete NEW image containing ONLY its year "1914", drawn as large as possible for a separate high-resolution title-row export. Match the reference year glyph shapes: the elegant classical serif 1, the round 9 with a descending diagonal tail, and the open triangular interior of the 4, with the same refined stroke weight and serifs. Match the quiet warm ivory color and thin dark outline of the reference, with no metallic glare, texture, engraving noise, 3D extrusion, glow or large shadow. Do not copy the main title text into this image.

Exact visible text: 1914
Four characters only, in one horizontal line: one, nine, one, four. No other letters, words, dates, punctuation, divider, border, frame, labels, symbols or scenery.

Layout: aim for 3000 x 1100 native pixels or the largest available wide output. The four digits should fill approximately 88 to 92 percent of the canvas WIDTH, leaving small safe transparent margins around the outer serifs. Uniform spacing matching the reference year. Keep every digit complete and sharp. This file will be displayed smaller beneath the separately exported main title; do not put a small year inside a big empty canvas. Produce the large source glyphs only.

True transparent alpha around the digits and inside the 9 and 4 counters. No opaque black or white background, no checkerboard painted into the pixels, no background plate. Exact same warm ivory fill and continuous thin dark brown outline as reference. One complete new image, no partial local repair.
